title: Pets
passage: Many families in Japan have pets. Dogs and cats are very popular. Some people live in small apartments, so they keep small animals like fish or hamsters.
pictureAlt: A living room. An orange cat is sleeping on the sofa. A boy is feeding a goldfish in a fishbowl.

questions.text: Please look at the passage. Why do some people keep small animals like fish or hamsters?
questions.tip: “so” の前を探そう。“Because they …” で答えよう。
questions.model: Because they live in small apartments.

questions.text: Please look at the picture. Where is the cat?
questions.tip: 場所を答えよう。“It is on / under …”

questions.text: What time do you usually get up?
questions.tip: “I usually get up at …” で答えよう。
questions.model: I usually get up at six thirty.

questions.tip: まず Yes か No で答えよう。
questions.model: Yes, I do. / No, I don't.

followYes.tip: もう1文、くわしく言おう。
followYes.model: I have a dog, and I walk him every morning.

followNo.model: Because I am afraid of dogs.
